ArgonTest.Name: Static methods
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _ import Argon.Core::*
record RecordOwner public def static.message(): String = "record static" public def self.message(): String = "record instance" end
enum EnumOwner public def static.message(): String = "enum static" Value end
trait TraitOwner public def static.message(): String = "trait static" end
record GenericOwner(token T: type) public def static.identity(value: T): T = value end
proc main(): () do puts (RecordOwner.message ()) puts (EnumOwner.message ()) puts (TraitOwner.message ()) puts (GenericOwner(String).identity "generic static") end
ArgonTest.ExpectedOutput: record static enum static trait static generic static
